card.name: Linking word after withhold or stop drug
card.fires_on: The word "and" (sometimes a comma or "be") right after an instruction to withhold, stop, or interrupt a named drug. It sits where the next action, such as initiating or monitoring something, will follow.

modes.label: Stop drug, then next step
modes.description: "and" or a comma after withhold, discontinue, or stop plus the drug name, before a follow-up action.
modes.example: If differentiation syndrome is suspected, withhold REZLIDHIA<< and>> initiate treatment with corticosteroids and

modes.label: Passive interrupt wording
modes.description: "be" after the drug or therapy when it must be interrupted or suspended.
modes.example: Should treatment with any of these agents be required, it is recommended that therapy with toremifene citrate tablets<< be>> interrupted.

card.writes: It seems to push toward action verbs like initiate or start (init-type tokens) as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the small word after "stop the drug" in dosing instructions, just before the next action is named.
